Sora2.prompt: A cinematic 7-second shot in ancient Chinese anime style. Two characters in tense standoff inside a dilapidated room at night. A young Chinese woman in pale green hanfu dress stands on the right side of frame with determined yet nervous expression, her fists slightly clenched, waiting for response. On the left, a pale young man with long black hair sits in a wooden wheelchair, his sharp eyes filled with suspicion as his gaze scrutinizes her, a sword still raised beside him. Camera slowly dollys out from medium two-shot to wide full shot, revealing the entire dimly lit room. Single blue oil lamp flickers in the corner, casting dancing cold-blue and warm-gold shadows across the space. The characters form a diagonal composition with increasing negative space between them. Atmosphere is heavy with unresolved tension and impending danger. Cold blue-grey color palette with warm candlelight accents. Cliffhanger ending with fade-to-darkness aesthetic. Slow ease-in-out camera movement, linear pull-back path.
